name: Calculator Suite
summary: A calm, dense pocket toolbox (Apple Calculator meets Raycast): a searchable home with pinned favourite tiles that show their last answer, and 8 calculators with one giant answer each, Copy + Save to history, remembered inputs and a print option where it helps: loan payment with amortization chart and table, markup/margin/discount/sales tax (type any two boxes, the rest solve themselves), tip & split, percentages, unit converter (7 kinds), time card & pay with overtime, tire size compare with speedometer error, and fuel trip cost / fill-up MPG.

sections.name: facts
sections.what: Hidden spans holding {{business}}, {{phone}}, {{email}}, {{address}} for the top bar and printed letterheads

sections.name: view-home
sections.what: Tools tab: search (Enter opens the first match), Pinned tiles with each calculator's last answer, every calculator grouped as Money / Work / Convert / Auto with a pin star
sections.edit: Usually no change; the list itself comes from CALCS in app.js (section 6)

sections.name: view-calc
sections.what: Shell of every calculator page: group, name, one-line blurb, Pin and Start over buttons, the calculator template, its Saved answers

sections.name: calc-loan
sections.what: Loan payment: amount, APR, length in years or months, optional extra per month. Answer: monthly payment, total interest, total paid, payoff time, interest saved by the extra. Stacked yearly principal/interest chart, year or month table, Print schedule
sections.edit: Rename labels if needed; keep input names and data-out keys

sections.name: calc-pricing
sections.what: Markup, margin & tax: three modes. Margin (cost, price, markup %, margin %, profit), Discount (original, % off, sale, saved), Sales tax (before tax, rate, tax, total). Any two boxes solve the rest; boxes are tagged typed/auto
sections.edit: Keep names; the default tax rate is whatever the owner last typed

sections.name: calc-tip
sections.what: Tip & split: bill, tip % with quick chips, people stepper, tax already in the bill (tip on pre-tax), round each share up. Exact split to the cent (some pay 1 cent more)
sections.edit: Change the quick tip chips (data-tip) for local custom

sections.name: calc-percent
sections.what: Percentages: four cards (X% of Y, what percent, percent change with increase/decrease, plus or minus a percent), each with its own answer and Copy

sections.name: calc-units
sections.what: Unit converter: length, weight, volume, temperature, speed, area, fuel economy; value, From, swap, To; list of the value in every unit (tap one to make it the target)
sections.edit: Add or remove units in UNITS in app.js (factor to the base unit)

sections.name: calc-timecard
sections.what: Time card & pay: pay rate, overtime multiplier, weekly and optional daily overtime limits, start/end/break for each day (overnight shifts work), Copy Monday to weekdays, Clear the week. Answer: hours, gross pay, regular/overtime split
sections.edit: Change the defaults (rate, 40 h, 1.5x) in CALCS.timecard.defaults

sections.name: calc-tire
sections.what: Tire size: current and new size (225/45R17, P/LT, ZR, 225/45-17, 33x12.50R15), speedometer reading. Answer: real speed, % taller/shorter, drawing of both tires to scale, side-by-side table (width, sidewall, diameter, circumference, revs per mile), Print for a customer
sections.edit: Edit the datalist of common sizes for the shop's usual sizes

sections.name: calc-fuel
sections.what: Fuel & trip cost: Trip cost (distance, economy, price, round trip, split) or Fill-up MPG (odometer readings or distance, fuel added, price); miles/gallons or km/litres

sections.name: view-history
sections.what: History tab: saved answers (newest first, search, delete with Undo, Clear); tap one to reopen its calculator with the same numbers

sections.name: view-settings
sections.what: Settings tab: currency symbol (+ quick picks), show cents, decimal places with a live example, US or metric units, a note that the look comes from the chosen style, backup/restore, reset every calculator

sections.name: doc-loan
sections.what: Printable loan schedule with the owner's letterhead

sections.name: doc-tire
sections.what: Printable tire comparison with the owner's letterhead

behaviors: answers update on every keystroke; inputs are remembered per calculator (AK.store('calculator-suite') under the {{slug}} namespace) and survive reloads
first visit shows a worked example in each calculator; Start over returns to it, with Undo
Copy puts a plain-text answer on the clipboard and saves it to History; Save keeps it without copying; the same answer is never saved twice in a row
favourite calculators are pinned to the top of Tools as tiles showing their last answer; DEFAULT_PINS in app.js chooses the starting pins
money rounds half away from zero to the cent (or whole units when cents are off); tax rounds like a receipt; tip splits add up exactly

edge cases answered in words: divide by zero, percent change from 0, margin of 100%, markup + margin without a price, rates over 100%, loans over 50 years, break longer than the shift, odometer going backwards, below absolute zero, unreadable tire sizes, over 3% tire size difference
phone: bottom tabs (Tools, History, Settings), answer first then inputs; computer: sidebar, inputs left and a sticky answer panel right
printing (loan schedule, tire comparison) uses AK.print with the owner's letterhead; works once published (Chrome)
style_notes: Works with every style; tested at 390 and 1280 with midnight-neon, clinical-clean, neo-brutalist, editorial-serif, soft-pastel, workshop-industrial, high-contrast-sport and minimal-mono (lint clean on every screen). The giant answers size themselves to their panel (narrow fonts like Bebas simply look a little smaller). Only kit colours are used; the accent appears on primary buttons, active chips, the pinned tile icons and the new tire in the drawing.
